title: tritonia lineata
intro: Tritonia lineata, commonly known as the 'Painted Lady', is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Iridaceae family. It is native to the Western Cape province of South Africa and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Tritonia lineata include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
